steps.action: Reuse pinned Factory/repository baseline when still valid; resolve exact source SHA and authorized scope, refresh only on an invalidation or explicit update.
Create one bounded branch for the step.

Run cheapest deterministic preflight covering touched sources BEFORE expensive CI. When instrumentation tests change, compile their test sources/APK first when feasible; check schema/migration/permission invariants as relevant. Fix known failures before retrying full CI.
Implement only the authorized behavior via minimum necessary process; assess genuine parallel-first workstreams once when the scope permits.
Run focused checks for actual blast radius after bounded hygiene; these do not replace required exact-head repository gates or higher-risk QA.
Open PR without importing unrelated maintenance findings.
Require all mandatory gates GREEN on the exact integrated head; reuse result/artifact only with matching source SHA, build contract, toolchain, signing and artifact identity, or rerun.
Merge only if mergeable and no blocking review/user gate remains.
